reset.reference_selection: minimum SHA256 of canonical C10 final weights among training rows; no labels used

settings.bootstrap_scope: test seed pairs conditional on frozen fitted probe
settings.covariate_adjustment: train-only OLS residualization of aligned standardized weights against six standardized diagnostics and intercept
settings.feature_input: final endpoint weights only; diagnostics/logits explicit secondary baselines
settings.hyperparameter_selection: validation BA, then validation logloss, then lambda list order; no refit on validation
settings.multiple_testing: one unadjusted primary; Holm across all 19 secondary endpoints including negative control
settings.permutation_method: independent within-pair swaps across all train/validation/test blocks, complete refit and validation lambda reselection
